title: New wp2shell WordPress Core Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code
summary: An anonymous HTTP request can run code on a WordPress site. The bug is in core, so a bare install with zero plugins is exploitable.

title: OpenSSL HollowByte Flaw Could Freeze Server Memory with 11-Byte TLS Requests
summary: Eleven bytes will make an unpatched OpenSSL server set aside up to 131 KB of memory for a message that never arrives. On the glibc systems Okta tested, that memory is gone until the process restarts.
